title: Deeper/broader DXF peer-claims and Autodesk contract reconciliation
scope: Reconcile ACadSharp issue #1253's CLASSES, HATCH, and DIMSTYLE claims with Autodesk's record-specific DXF references.
Check ACadSharp codepage, MTEXT, and SPLINE reports against already-existing local plan owners and generated tests.
Refine evidence grade and test ordering without adding implementation work.

sources.finding: Advises DXF reader authors to ignore undefined groups and avoid assuming fixed group-code order within entities; this is implementation guidance, not a guarantee that every record scope accepts every sequence.
Defines HATCH group 47 as pixel size used for associative/flood computation and lists it before group 98 seed count; does not establish a zero-value omission rule.
Documents common symbol-table header group 70 as the maximum-entry count and DIMSTYLE record handle code 105.
Defines DIMSTYLE record group 71 as DIMTOL and group 340 as the DIMTXSTY STYLE handle; does not describe the disputed AcDbDimStyleTable subclass payload.
Reporter says AutoCAD 2027 rejected three ACadSharp DXF output sequences; no raw AutoCAD DXF/hash or independent rerun was available in this review.
Synthetic Korean example separates declared $DWGCODEPAGE from actual legacy payload encoding.
Linked change remains non-release evidence and does not independently qualify output.
Frame-only MTEXT flag report is version- and whole-file-scoped; cause is unresolved by the reporter.
DWG-to-DXF SPLINE report lacks published offending entity identity, full curve arrays, exact downstream options, and independent expected geometry.
MTEXT fields are documented; the reference does not resolve the reported AC1032 whole-file rejection cause.
Documents SPLINE flags, counts, tolerances, knots, weights, control points, and fit points; does not establish expected geometry for the peer's private sample.

plan_changes: Do not generalize ACadSharp #1253 into a globally strict ordered-DXF-parser rule; retain it as record/profile-specific AutoCAD acceptance evidence.
Keep HATCH group-47 zero behavior unresolved pending exact profile evidence.
Keep DIMSTYLE table-header 71/340 as a candidate census; separate it from table group 70 and record-level 71/340 semantics.
Reuse existing generated CP949, MTEXT, CLASS/HATCH, and SPLINE test owners; add no duplicate test or external fixture.
limitations: ACadSharp issue observations remain peer-reported and do not establish libdxfrw defects or support claims.
Mutable project issue pages and current-source references are not release qualification.
Native AutoCAD acceptance remains a one-time composed checkpoint, not a per-slice requirement.
